name: House
description: A family home with the life still arranged around the absence. The front door may be locked, broken, or barricaded from the inside, and the ordinary rooms hold ordinary things that have become supplies.
find_hint: Any residential street has a dozen. The hard part is choosing one that has not already been opened.

name: Military Checkpoint
